prova:
have hF : ∀ N : ℕ, F N ≤ N := F_le
  have h12 : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → (F N : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4 + 1) := by
    intro N h1N
    have h1 : (F N : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by
      norm_cast
      exact F_le N
    have h2 : 0 < (N : ℝ) := by
      norm_cast
      exact Nat.one_le_iff_lt_succ.mpr (by omega)
    have h3 : (N : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4 + 1) ≥ (N : ℝ) := by
      have h3a : ((1 : ℝ) / 4 + 1 : ℝ) = (5 : ℝ) / 4 := by ring
      rw [h3a]
      have h3b : 1 ≤ (5 : ℝ) / 4 := by norm_num
      have h3c : 1 ≤ (N : ℝ) := by norm_cast; omega
      have h3d : 0 ≤ (N : ℝ) := by linarith
      exact pow_le_pow (by linarith) h3c h3b
    linarith
  have hFin : ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in atTop, 1 ≤ N := by
    intro N hN
    omega
  refine ⟨fun _ => 1, by
    constructor
    · exact tendsto_const_nhds
    · exact Filter.eventually_of_forall (fun N hN => by
        simpa [show (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) N = (1 : ℝ) from rfl] using h12 N hN)
  ⟩
